name: Graphify
tagline: Explore codebases, trace dependencies, and recall repository knowledge
description: Connect Cline to Graphify’s hosted code knowledge graph. Search indexed repositories for code evidence, trace callers and dependencies, assess change impact, and save or recall repository knowledge. Requires a Graphify account and an indexed repository in a workspace you can access. Results depend on indexing status and account permissions; some memory features depend on your plan.

install.notes: Sign in to Graphify through the browser when prompted for OAuth. Create or select your workspace and index a repository at https://app.graphify.com before querying code. Memory tools can write saved knowledge; approve those actions only when intended.
